==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
My childhood dog who passed away years ago has returned. He is now the size of a building. He has patches of grass that grow in his fur.

He has been recruited to help defend against a group of invaders. These invaders resemble goblins. Despite being aliens, they dress like humans.

While my dog is dealing with the goblins, I start to hear a humming sound. I listen closely and the humming sound becomes a message from another world. The sender of the message likes and fears the Earth, describing the planet as the universe's delivery hotel.
